bullets: How do you map the same physical room across hundreds of differently worded supplier descriptions, in different languages, with extremely high confidence?
When should the system prioritize coverage versus precision, and how do you increase coverage without degrading accuracy?
How do you identify the highest-value mapping failures and focus the team where better mapping creates the biggest customer or commercial impact?
How do we manage credit lines and financial exposure as transaction volumes grow, reducing risk without limiting business growth?
How do we support complex client-specific payment requirements, including virtual cards, charging rules, and payment timing, without creating operational complexity?
How do we make ledgers, financial workflows, and payment operations more scalable, reliable, and automated as the business grows?
How do we choose the best supply across hundreds of supplier connections for each search?
How should pricing and margin change across customers, suppliers, markets, and booking contexts to grow take rate and revenue while staying competitive?
How do we separate distribution decisions from the technical constraints of querying suppliers synchronously?
How do we raise fulfillment rate and cut incident/ticket volume without growing CS headcount or cost in proportion?
What internal tooling would let CS resolve problems faster, with less manual work and fewer handoffs?
Where should we invest in CS systems to get the clearest return, in P&L terms, for the company?
